user.title: 🪟 HA Window – step 1 of 5: shade
user.description: Pick the shade of this window. For a two-sash window pick two shades (left and right) or one group.

data_description.name: E.g. Living room. The device will be called “Okno Living room”.

okno.title: 🪟 Step 2 of 5: window and sensors
okno.description: How many sashes the window has and whether it has open sensors. Sensors are optional.

data_description.czujnik_lewe: When the sensor shows open, the card draws an open sash.
data_description.tryb_lewe: How the card shows an open sash.

silnik.title: ⚙️ Step 3 of 5: motor
silnik.description: The card moves at the motor's speed. If the motor has a speed setting (e.g. Moes), pick it. Everything here is optional.

pogoda.title: 🌤️ Step 4 of 5: weather outside
pogoda.description: Real weather shows outside the window. Leave empty and the card uses internet weather for your home.

wyglad.title: 🎨 Step 5 of 5: look
wyglad.description: Shade type, colour and frame. You can change everything later in “Configure”.

data_description.kolor: You can also type your own colour, e.g. #3a3d42.
data_description.rama: You can also type your own colour, e.g. #f4f4f2.
